article.story: Texas A&M (3-2) at No. 14 Missouri (4-1), Oct. 10 at 12 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Missouri by 3.5. Against the spread: Missouri 2-3, Texas A&M 3-2. How to watch: ABC Key stats Missouri Offense Overall: 447 yards per game (39th in FBS) Passing: 278.4 yards per game (29th) Rushing: 168.6 yards per game (59th) Scoring: 37.6 points per game (25th) Missouri Defense Overall: 320 yards per game (47th in FBS) Passing: 231.2 yards per game (99th) Rushing: 88.8 yards per game (15th) Scoring: 20 points per game (48th) Texas A&M Offense Overall: 356.2 yards per game (98th in FBS) Passing: 188.8 yards per game (104th) Rushing: 167.4 yards per game (60th) Scoring: 31.8 points per game (64th) Texas A&M Defense Overall: 312.8 yards per game (41st in FBS) Passing: 191.8 yards per game (44th) Rushing: 121 yards per game (48th) Scoring: 18.6 points per game (38th) Texas A&M is 11th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 26.4% of third downs. Missouri ranks 112th in the FBS averaging 68.4 penalty yards per game, compared to Texas A&M's 16th-ranked 40.8 per-game average. Missouri is 105th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 79.2% of trips. Texas A&M's red zone defense ranks 9th at 69.2%. Missouri is 67th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 30:14, compared to Texas A&M's 8th-ranked average of 33:59. Team leaders Missouri Passing: Austin Simmons, 1,287 yards, 13 TDs, 0 INTs, 67.9 completion percentage Rushing: Jamal Roberts, 606 yards on 113 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Cayden Lee, 513 yards on 34 catches, 4 TDs Texas A&M Passing: Marcel Reed, 908 yards, 6 TDs, 4 INTs, 57.0 completion percentage Rushing: Rueben Owens, 291 yards on 70 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Isaiah Horton, 248 yards on 17 catches, 3 TDs Last game Missouri won 45-17 over Florida on Oct. 3. Simmons led Missouri with 340 yards on 23-of-30 passing (76.7%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. Roberts carried the ball 24 times for 211 yards and scored three touchdowns, adding three receptions for 29 yards. Lee had eight receptions for 110 yards. Texas A&M won 34-7 over Arkansas on Oct. 3. Reed threw for 170 yards on 13-of-19 attempts (68.4%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 66 yards and one rushing touchdown. K.J. Edwards had 66 rushing yards on 11 carries and two touchdowns. Kiotti Armstrong recorded 54 yards on one catch. Next game Missouri plays at No. 9 Ole Miss on Oct. 17. Texas A&M hosts Citadel on Oct. 17.
